name: minidroid
description: MiniDroid engineering skill for analyzing, testing, debugging and extending the portable Android compatibility runtime for Linux x86_64.

interface.longDescription: Develop, inspect, test and debug MiniDroid, a portable Android compatibility runtime for Linux x86_64. Work with APK execution, Android Activity lifecycle, resources, Views, the MiniDroid Manager, ART/Bionic, package and process management, ADB, add-ons and compatibility packs while preserving the lightweight MiniDroid architecture.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the bundled MiniDroid runtime and report its current state.
Debug this MiniDroid APK launch failure without regressing the working runtime.
Implement the requested MiniDroid feature and run the relevant regression tests.

publication.release_notes: MiniDroid developer plugin with bundled runtime, official icon, public privacy policy and MiniDroid engineering skill.
